$comment: G-OVERVIEW-STATION PROPOSAL overlay (mock only, D-162): GET /api/v1/overview/stations/items?line=<line>&station=<station>&limit=<1-50, default 10>&cursor=<opaque> reads the work at one station of the factory floor, for the 3D floor's readout strip. Not in v7. Visible to whoever may read E-OVERVIEW, and only the records that person may see (restricted records are left out of items but kept in total, so the count matches the floor). Order: needs a person first, then the longest waiting. 404 not_found for a line or station that is not on the floor; 404 invalid_query for a bad limit or cursor. The mock is mock/station-items.mjs.
